title: Busch Stadium
geometryBasis: The named stadium multipolygon supplies 145 outer and 55 inner controls. Native playing-surface relations locate the turf and warning track, and six mapped gate nodes anchor exterior openings.
sectionBasis: Tall red seating decks and a narrow dark canopy surround the first-base, third-base and behind-home-plate stands. The deck drops toward the open northeast outfield with red-brick gates, field-level bleachers and two large video boards.
limitations: Deck and roof heights, the Eads Bridge-inspired entrance span, chosen seating subdivisions, and details in areas outside the cleared photos are estimates.
The stadium sits on an original composite terrain field. The playing surface is below the west entry, and the approximate field plane is based on the interior source heights.
floorBasis: Known park grade falls toward the east and the field is below the west entry. The frozen site field fixes the relative approach grade. The playing surface is set at a representative elevation just above the lower field samples.
